assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas, ratios, figures and drawings must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.resolution: Replace site_boundary/key_areas, regenerate all design layers, metrics, figures, HTML and PDFs.

assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road redlines, heritage controls, cadastral ownership, existing building survey and municipal capacities are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No FAR, height, demolition, bridge/tunnel, underground or utility-capacity conclusion is made.
assumptions.resolution: Professional teams must confirm official attachments and surveys before statutory or engineering use.

assumptions.statement: Twelve small polygons indicate the spatial relationship of ground-floor rooms and back-of-house interfaces.
assumptions.impact: They do not represent surveyed buildings, parcel ownership or approved construction footprints.
assumptions.resolution: Re-anchor to surveyed buildings and real leases after access/ownership verification.

assumptions.statement: The nine cross-gate lines are public-space and slow-mobility design intentions, not road centerlines or redlines.
assumptions.impact: Lengths are only internal design quantities and cannot support engineering design.
assumptions.resolution: Verify each gate by as-built drawings, field accessibility audit and traffic assessment.

assumptions.statement: Events, leases, operating funds and partnerships are design proposals.
assumptions.impact: No government, institution, enterprise, funding or investment commitment is claimed.
assumptions.resolution: Convert proposals into agreements only after named parties approve roles, budgets, insurance and exit clauses.
